title: Two numbers to call when at home now one (wish I had seven many gone some walking forgotten) but two now one May not know forgot to listen but you're
summary: Two numbers to call when at home now one (wish I had seven many gone some walking forgotten) but two now one May not know forgot to listen but you're missed glad you chose how to hang up the phone #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Two numbers to call
  when at home
now one
 (wish I had seven
    many gone
  some walking forgotten)
but two
  now one
May not
  know
forgot to
  listen
but you're
   missed
glad you
chose how to hang
 up the phone
#smallpoems
